description: The driver's recorded GPS route (breadcrumb trail) for a booking's trip: the path actually driven, with a distance and duration summary, for route playback or attendance checks. The trail is recorded only while the driver is on the job and kept for 30 days. Identity is the booking reference plus the passenger email; staff callers may use the numeric reservation ID alone.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — "APL-<LT reservation id>" (e.g. "APL-1013869") or the numeric LT reservation ID.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking (required for partner/customer lookups; optional for internal staff using a numeric reservation ID).

name: get_driver_route
title: Get Driver Route
